🎓 Official $CBSE Board Academic Formula

$CBSE Board CGPA to Percentage Guide (2025-26)

$CBSE Class 10th and 12th CGPA to Percentage Calculator. Use this free calculator to convert your semester grade point averages (SGPA) and cumulative aggregate (CGPA) into certified percentage marks for job applications, GATE, CAT, and higher studies abroad.

🧮 Official $CBSE Board Formula Breakdown

$CBSE uses the standard formula: Percentage = CGPA × 9.5

This mathematical conversion rule is mandated by official examination ordinances issued by $CBSE Board to align student transcripts with national AICTE/UGC standards.

Placement & Exam Eligibility Cutoffs for $CBSE Board Students

💼 IT Mass Recruiters (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture)

Requires a minimum aggregate of 60% or 6.5+ CGPA with maximum 1 active backlog at the time of campus drives.

🏛️ Government & PSU Exams (GATE, ISRO, BARC, Coal India)

Mandates First Class degree certification (minimum 60% aggregate or equivalent CGPA as certified by university registrar).

✈️ Foreign Higher Studies (MS in US, UK, Germany, Canada)

Target a minimum 3.0 / 4.0 GPA equivalent (7.5+ CGPA) for top-tier university admissions and teaching assistantship grants.
